text.en: Visual Curator limits moving arrows by connection length, distinguishes conversation preparation from search progress, groups task details and wallpaper settings and offers a floating task capsule only in sufficiently wide Chat views.
text.zh-CN: 视觉策展按连线长度控制移动箭头密度，区分会话准备与实际检索进度，优化任务详情和壁纸设置分组，并在宽度足够的对话页提供悬浮任务胶囊。
